sloka: शलभा इव केदारं मशका इव पर्वतम् ।यथामृतघटं दंशा मकरा इव चार्णवम् ।। ७.७.३ ॥
transliteration: śalabhā iva kedāraṁ maśakā iva parvatam ।yathāmṛtaghaṭaṁ daṁśā makarā iva cārṇavam ।। 7.7.3 ॥

translations.english: Just as locusts swarm a field, mosquitoes a mountain, flies a pot of nectar, and crocodiles the ocean, so too did the arrows approach Hari.
